Instrument.name: Lunar Trailblazer Spacecraft Lunar Thermal Mapper
Instrument.description: The Lunar Trailblazer (LT) Spacecraft Lunar Thermal Mapper (LTM) is a multispectral infrared imager designed to map temperature (110-400 K), physical properties, and composition. The spatial resolution of the instrument is 25 m/pixel over 11 km width. It has 4 broadband thermal channels 6-100 μm and 11 compositional channels 7-10 μm. The LTM components include a five-mirror telescope and optical system and an uncooled microbolometer detector array.
